page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is an x86_64 cloud instance configured for memory-intensive enterprise workloads requiring fast, high-density local storage. It is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors providing 45 physical cores and 90 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Compute capabilities include hardware instruction support for AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, VAES, and SHA-NI, paired with a 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster.

The server provides 720 GB of system memory, matching an 8 GB per vCPU allocation characteristic of high-memory tiers. For I/O demands, the instance bundles 3,216 GB of local NVMe solid-state storage across eight drives. There are no discrete hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in the profile.

Benchmark evaluations show high parallel computing capacity. The instance achieves top-tier results in PassMark CPU tests (87,474.24), extended instruction routines (115,257.04), and stress-ng multi-core throughput (129,175.86). Memory subsystem performance remains competitive, registering 217.31 GB/sec on large uncached read sweeps and 6,368.24 GB/sec under cached small-block memory reads. Software build tasks and ray tracing execution also place in the top decile. In contrast, single-threaded processing scores in the middle tier, such as Geekbench single-core at 1,879.0 and large-block memory writes at 77.28 GB/sec.

The balanced pairing of 720 GB RAM and 3.2 TB of bundled NVMe disk makes the instance resource-efficient for massive datasets that demand rapid local staging without remote block storage overhead. Optimal deployments include in-memory data grids, large distributed transactional databases, Redis caching layers, and high-concurrency software compilation pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized compute instance designed for heavy data architectures and intensive I/O operations. Built on an x86_64 architecture using AMD EPYC 9B14 series processors, the configuration delivers 90 dedicated vCPUs (45 physical cores) alongside 720 GB of memory. It incorporates 3,216 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage across eight integrated disks, without attached GPUs. In benchmark assessments, the instance displays top-tier multi-threaded CPU output, exceptional code compilation metrics, and sustained high-volume read bandwidth. Single-threaded metrics and uncached write speeds register in average percentiles, underscoring that processing efficiency scales primarily with parallel load. The combination of dense memory allocation and bundled low-latency NVMe arrays makes this server suitable for large relational database operations, in-memory analytics engines, distributed caching nodes, and multi-core compilation tasks.
